scripts.dotnet:publish: dotnet publish ../src/MrKWatkins.OakIO.Wasm/MrKWatkins.OakIO.Wasm.csproj -c Release -o /tmp/oakio-wasm && node scripts/copy-dotnet-to-docs.mjs && node scripts/generate-dotnet-boot.mjs
scripts.dotnet:api: dotnet build ../src/MrKWatkins.OakIO/MrKWatkins.OakIO.csproj -c Release && dotnet build ../src/MrKWatkins.OakIO.ZXSpectrum/MrKWatkins.OakIO.ZXSpectrum.csproj -c Release && sesharp ../src/MrKWatkins.OakIO/bin/Release/net10.0/MrKWatkins.OakIO.dll ../src/MrKWatkins.OakIO.ZXSpectrum/bin/Release/net10.0/MrKWatkins.OakIO.ZXSpectrum.dll --output docs/API --repository https://github.com/MrKWatkins/OakIO
scripts.build: npm run dotnet:publish && npm run dotnet:api && npm run build:vite && npm run build:mkdocs
scripts.serve: npm run dotnet:publish && npm run dotnet:api && npm run build:vite && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-others "npm:serve:mkdocs" "npm:serve:vite"
